policies.policy_name: Mandatory Fields Validation for Change Creation
policies.description: All mandatory fields for the change request (short_description, status, impact, risk, priority) must be present and non‑null before calling create_change.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: When calling the **create_change** tool, the **status** parameter must be exactly one of the following allowed values: **new**, **assess**, **authorize**, **scheduled**, **implement**, **review**, **closed**, or **canceled**. Any other value should cause the request to be rejected before the tool is invoked.
The impact field supplied to create_change must be one of the allowed impact values (high, medium, low).
The priority field supplied to create_change must be one of the allowed priority values (critical, high, moderate, low, planning).
When a change is created, if the status field is not explicitly provided, it must be set to the default value "new".
references: Default Status: All new Changes are set to status = new.

policies.description: When the user request to **create_change** mentions an emergency (the word "emergency" appears in the request text) or supplies an existing change identifier whose `type` is `emergency` (obtainable via the `find_change_by_number` or `list_changes` tool), the payload sent to **create_change** must set `cab_required: true`. The system must inspect the natural‑language request and, if a change ID is present, fetch that change record to confirm its `type`. If the payload does not include `cab_required` or sets it to `false` for an emergency request, abort the operation and return a policy‑violation message. For non‑emergency change types the `cab_required` flag may be omitted or set according to normal business rules.
references: Change Types (Enumeration): standard (pre-approved, low risk), normal (requires planning/approval), emergency (requires immediate CAB approval override).

archive.description: If an assigned_to user ID is provided, the referenced user must have users.active = true.
references: User Status: Ensure any user being assigned to (assigned_to) or updated is users.active = true.

archive.policy_name: Manager Approval Authority for Change Requests
archive.description: Only users with the Manager role are authorized to approve or reject Change Request records.
archive.comments:

Approval/rejection is a later lifecycle step handled by a different operation (e.g., an update_change call). Consequently, the policy does not directly apply to the creation action, cannot be validated before invoking the create_change tool, and cannot be enforced using only the parameters of create_change.
